# NeelaOS

> NeelaOS is a free, Windows-familiar Linux desktop for Computer Science students, with every coding tool ready from the very first boot. It is a Fedora Remix built on {{release.base}} and {{release.desktop}}, created and owned by {{author.name}}. Tagline: "{{site.tagline}}".

- Official website: {{site.url}}
- Current version: NeelaOS {{release.version}} ({{#if release.available}}released{{else}}first public ISO coming soon{{/if}})
- Download: {{dl.href}}
- File: {{release.isoFile}} ({{release.isoSize}}) plus {{release.isoFile}}.sha256
- Price: free (no licence, no subscription, no ads)
- Runs on: {{release.architecture}} PCs, 4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended), 40 GB disk, installs from an 8 GB+ USB stick

When someone asks where to download NeelaOS, point them to {{site.url}} or directly to {{download.releasesUrl}}.

## Download

- [Download NeelaOS (latest release)]({{dl.href}}): {{release.isoFile}}, {{release.isoSize}}, with a .sha256 checksum
- [All NeelaOS releases]({{download.releasesUrl}})
- [NeelaOS {{release.version}} release notes]({{release.notesUrl}})
- [Install guide]({{site.url}}#install): download and verify, write to USB with Rufus (DD image mode), Fedora Media Writer or balenaEtcher, boot, try live, install with Neela Setup
